caveats: Paper 1 = 160: Cuid I listening 60 (Cuid A 18 = Fógra 1 10 (four questions, Q2 at 2 + 2) + Fógra 2 8 (four); Cuid B 28 = Comhrá 1 14 (Mír 1 6 + Mír 2 8) + Comhrá 2 14 (Mír 1 8, 1(a) at 2 + 2, + Mír 2 6); Cuid C 14 = Píosa 1 6 (three) + Píosa 2 8 (four)); Cuid II composition 100 (choose one of A, B, C, D).

Layout: the paper is the answer booklet for Cuid I. The cover (PDF 1) carries the instructions; Cuid A is on paper page 2, B on 3–4, C on 5; the composition Treoracha and the examiner’s box are on page 6 and the choice, length note and titles on page 7; page 8 is blank.

The 2012 listening key prints its tariffs and prices with no unit: a question’s tariff in brackets after it (“(2)”, “(2 + 2)”, “(2+2)”) and each answer “= 2”, “= 0”, “= 1 + 1”, “= 2 + 2”, once “= 2m” (Píosa a Dó 3(b)). Every chunk is asserted to carry no “marc”.

Comhrá a hAon, An Dara Mír 3(a) prints its answer lines welded by a lost line break: “Óna naoi go dtí a ceathair = 1 + 09 go dtí 4.05 = 1 + 1 9 go 16.05 = 1 + 19 go 4 = 1 + 0” is four answers (“Óna naoi go dtí a ceathair = 1 + 0”, “9 go dtí 4.05 = 1 + 1”, “9 go 16.05 = 1 + 1”, “9 go 4 = 1 + 0”); every price is a single digit, so the reader cuts after the digit.

Comhrá a Dó’s key (PDF 10) prints a boxed caution, “Cúramach”, with an arrow to the An Chéad Mhír heading; the text layer sets it after 1(a)’s “3 nóiméad 41(.2) soicind = 2”. It is cut from 1(a)’s answers by exact match and not carried on a card.

Comhrá a Dó 1(a) prints an answer with five numbered elements, “bhí [searmanas]1 [ina onóir]2 [i gCaisleán Bhaile Átha Cliath]3 [le déanaí]4 chun [comóradh a dhéanamh]5 Dhá eilimint = 2 Eilimint amháin = 0”, kept as printed.
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 3 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3; it is one section-level deduction, stated in each card note without being applied.

Misprints kept as printed: the paper numbers Fógra a Dó’s last question “4.” (it prints no 3; the scheme “3.”), prints “Ronnie Dealney” (Comhrá a Dó 1(a)), “lúthcleasaíocht” (An Dara Mír Q3) and “Leigh tú alt” (Ceapadóireacht C(a)); the scheme reprints “Cé mhéad daltaí” (Fógra a hAon 1(b)), “faoin athrú san amchlár” (Comhrá a hAon 3(b); paper “faoi athrú san amhchlár”), “Cén post ata” (Píosa a hAon Q2), opens Fógra a Dó 2(b)’s first answer “éigh (daltaí …” (for “léigh”), and prints “Maire” for “Máire” in the transcript. Each card shows the paper’s question and the scheme’s answers.

Composition 2012 is Ionramháil Ábhair 20 + Cumas Gaeilge 80 (PDF 13), with the Ábhar bands A 17–20 … F/NG 0–4 (PDF 15) and the 80-mark table A ard 76–80 … N/G íseal 0–3 (PDF 14); it prints no Stíl mark, no S1–S4 grades and no short-attempt reductions. Its first Ábhar band, “Ionramháil an-mhaith ar fad → sármhaith”, draws the arrow with Wingdings U+F0E0, read as “→”; the cover tariffs (PDF 3) draw × with SymbolMT U+F0B4, read as “×” in the searchable scheme text.

Má bhíonn an chóir iompair lag ní féidir na smaointe a chur i láthair go héifeachtach. Bíonn sé deacair na smaointe a aimsiú má bhíonn an Ghaeilge lag nó bearnach.
